{{Top|leg}}
Boss '''Trome''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. At some point, Trome visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sevetta/Legends|Sevetta]] and pressed a [[Polydroxol]] into service. The crime lord directed the Polydroxol to attack the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Gideon (spacer)|Gideon]] and [[Keeta]].<ref name="SS">{{JournalCite|12|Shape-shifters}}</ref>
